responsibility: This module contains GNU Modula-2’s GCC plugin-side analysis logic, centered on whole-program inspection of generated GIMPLE to recognize Modula-2 runtime exception handling behavior and its reachability. Its files implement plugin passes that are registered into GCC’s pass pipeline, walk functions and basic blocks after optimization, classify relevant calls such as runtime exception handlers versus ordinary or externally visible functions, and build analysis graphs used at plugin finalization to discover which runtime-exception paths are reachable. In practice, this makes the module the bridge between the Modula-2 front end/runtime conventions and GCC’s generic plugin and IR infrastructure, providing post-lowering control-flow and call-graph style analysis rather than language parsing, code generation, or target-specific support.
